programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.10
programme.desc: After discovering that Jeongi is a woman, Gwanghae urges her to flee at once. Instead, Jeongi asks for just ten days—enough time to complete the celadon teacups for Yukdo. Hearing rumors that Jeongi and Gwanghae share more than a simple connection, Imhae devises a scheme and locks the two of them together in a single room.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.11
programme.desc: Gwanghae orders Gangcheon to acknowledge Jeongi's achievements and reinstate her at the Bunwon workshop. Soon after, he learns from Hwa-ryeong that Jeongi has already left with Taedo—and discovers the shocking truth that the two are not actually biological siblings. When Yukdo's life is placed in danger, Gangcheon reveals to King Seonjo and the visiting envoy that it was Jeongi who crafted the teacups. As Taedo prepares to confess his feelings to Jeongi, Gwanghae suddenly appears…

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.12
programme.desc: While Gwanghae meets with the envoy, Taedo rescues Jeongi from the warehouse where she has been locked away. Watching Jeongi and Taedo walk off together, Gwanghae is flooded with memories from his past. Taedo warns Jeongi that if she chooses not to be entangled with Gwanghae any longer, she must never allow her true identity as “Jeongi” to be revealed. Back at the Bunwon, Jeongi begins learning the potter's wheel under Yukdo's guidance…

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.13
programme.desc: Consumed by anger, Gwanghae coldly tells Jeongi that she is no longer the person he once knew—and that she has nothing to do with him anymore. Left in tears as she gazes at the pottery she has made, Jeongi vows to earn Gwanghae's forgiveness. Meanwhile, in front of everyone at the Bunwon, Gangcheon orders that Euldam's vessels be destroyed…

programme.title: Last of the Right Whales

Instead they are run over by ships or suffer lethal injuries from fishing gear. If we don't stop killing them, in 20 years they could be extinct. From the only known calving grounds to the shifting feeding grounds, ‘Last of the Right Whales' follows the North Atlantic right whale migration and the people committed to saving a species still struggling to recover from centuries of hunting.

programme.title: Lake Magic
programme.desc: Mini land-bound oceans, lakes are a treasure trove of aquatic wonders. Lakes make up just 3% of the Earth's surface, but they hold 180,000 square kilometres of fresh water. From the shoreline to their depths are unique habitats teaming with life, home to everything from birds and bugs to frogs and fish. They can be anything from sanctuary from land predators and temperature regulators to bountiful food sources and pit-stops for migrating birdlife. Take a deep breath and dive into the magical world of lakes!

programme.title: The Heart of Hawaii
programme.desc: The Oahu island is the economic and cultural centre of the Hawaiian archipelago, as well as being a paradise for surfers, active holidaymakers and freedom lovers. The island is home to more than half of all natives and almost eight million foreign guests annually. Anyone searching for peace and seclusion won't find either in Honolulu or Waikiki. Traffic congestion and a backdrop of skyscrapers belong to the town panorama. Hip cafes, galleries and young fashion firms have settled here, adding a new and modern flair to the capital. Cindy's Lei Shoppe, the Chinatown florists, has been here for more than 30 years. This is also because the so-called Leis, the tradition of floral decoration, usually offered as a flower necklace or as a headdress, is still an important part of Hawaiian culture. Keone Nunes is well-known for his traditional tattooing skills, whereby the so-called Kakau Tattoos are virtually hammered into the skin with a hippo tooth. But Oahu is also an island of overwhelming natural beauty and a fascinating diversity on the smallest of places ...

programme.title: Secrets of the North Sea
programme.desc: The North Sea is enigmatic. It presents itself in cool shades of grey. Yet who would have guessed that beneath the chilly waves are opulent coral gardens, courting squids, and several of the largest sea creatures on the planet?

programme.title: Bosnia Herzegovina
programme.desc: Wild and unknown lies the still undiscovered natural paradise of Bosnia and Herzegovina in the heart of Europe. Rough mountains, dense forests and wild waterfalls characterize the picture of the untouched landscapes. Lynx, wolves and bears roam mountains and valleys. One of the last primeval forests in Europe is a retreat for many endangered animal species. Bosnia and Herzegovina is actually an undiscovered natural paradise in the middle of Europe.

programme.title: Bosnia Herzegovina
programme.desc: The barren, karstic south of the country, Herzegovina, also impresses with its natural landscapes. One of them is the Livno field. Not only is it the largest wetland in the country, it is also the largest regularly flooded karst field in the world. About 700 wild horses live in this unique landscape. Their ancestors were working horses that were abandoned here more than 50 years ago. Another special feature of the karst landscape are the rivers with their tufa barriers. The countless waterfalls that pour over it are a unique natural phenomenon.

programme.title: mareTV
programme.desc: Jersey: the Channel Island is one of the areas in the UK that can boast the most hours of annual sunshine. Not that Dave Cowburn cares very much. He works in the dark, cool ducts of an old bunker from the Sec-ond World War. Here, he breeds turbot, and is very successful at it, too. The "Jersey Royal", the regal potato, has been grown on the island since 1880, fertilized with seaweed from the surrounding ocean. In the third generation, Christine Hellio manages approximately 20 hectares on the coast. "The potato is our most important export commodity", she says. It is harvested by hand, as machines cannot be used on the steep fields. The price is quite regal, too: One kilogram costs 6 Euros. Hugh Gill is one of around 240 voluntary police officers on Jersey. The Honorary Police is regarded as the oldest organised police system in the world. Hugh works for them for one week every month. On the green lanes, the streets of Jersey, the speed limit is 15 miles per hour. Jersey has an immense tidal range and with up to 13 metres difference, it is the world's third largest. This is good for a rarity: the Ormer - one of the world's most expensive species of snail.

programme.title: mareTV
programme.desc: The palm tree laden beaches on Mexico's Riviera Maya on the Yucatan peninsula are endless, and the turquoise sea with its gentle Caribbean surf is a warm 25 degrees during the mild winter in this part of the world. Between Cancún and Punta Allen, where once there was little more than bushland and a few sleepy fishing villages, vibrant life has evolved during the past three decades. Richard Sowa has lived on a floating island for the past 15 years: an island he built himself out of empty plastic bottles. The bon vivant him-self sees it as a "solution for our planet's refuse problem". Off Punta Allen, a village in the bay of Sian Ka'an, Mexican Mara Coral Ley and her cousin Kim, continue to catch lobsters by adhering to the traditional method and were awarded an "Eco seal for sustainable fishing" for their trouble. It is silent under water off Isla Mujeres and it is here that the artist Jason deCaires has constructed a sculpture park. Hundreds of lifesize figures form an artificial reef at a depth of 12 metres. Fish and plants complete his work of art. The master himself is convinced: "Mother Nature is the true artist".

programme.title: Wild Serbia
programme.desc: Serbia is in the heart of the Balkans, a “little Europe“ within Europe with its rich variety of landscapes and natural beauties, it certainly does this name justice. This nature documentary presents Serbia's breath-taking, picturesque regions and unique wildlife on a journey to the most beautiful and wildest areas of the Balkan peninsula, from high mountains across gentle hills to the vast plains of the Puszta. Serbia is only about five times the size of Schleswig Holstein, yet here the most varied vegetation zones, animal kingdoms and cultures meet. And even today a large number of Serbian people live in close communion with nature. They are proud of the storks' nests in the villages, the ancient species of livestock that have been preserved and the vultures that return to make their home here. In many places people are pleased to see bears, lynx and wolves, and even jackals are at home in the forests of Siberia. It is a country full of traditions and folklore, with deep influences from the Orient as well as the West. The Danube is the most prominent river in Serbia. As it makes its way through the Carpathian Mountains of Rumania it forms the most imposing gorge in Europe, the Iron Gates. Other striking features of Serbia's landscape include the archaic earth pyramids of Devil's Town, towering up in powerful red colours - and what must be the driest region of Siberia, the Deliblatska Pescara, which is also known as Europe's Sahara. Colourful birds called bee-eaters have settled on a rocky slope - a whole, noisy colony of them. They make their nests in caves which they dig themselves in the ground, and the inaccessible location means it is difficult for enemies to reach them. The more frequently the male brings the female insects it has caught, the more powerful is the bond between them later.

programme.title: The Mediterranean South
programme.desc: From the dreamlike Mediterranean and spectacular canyon landscapes of Andalusia, to the expanses of the Extremadura with its holm oak forests that stretch toward the horizon. Even in the south of Spain, highly popular with holidaymakers, there is still much waiting to be discovered. Genets hunt for prey under cover of night. These viverrid representatives can be found in their greatest numbers on the Iberian Peninsula. And nowhere else in Europe are there as many vultures as here in Spain. It's an unparalleled spectacle, when griffon vultures quarrel over carrion. The European Chameleon has a by far more ingenious method of feeding: within a fraction of a second, he shoots out his half-a-metre-long tongue once in his sights, the insects don't have a chance. The unmistakeable hoopoe with his typical feather bonnet is also pleased with the rich variety of insects on offer in Spain. Especially in the spring, when the birds have to feed their insatiable juniors. With around 30,000 brooding couples, white storks have one of their most important areas of distribution in Spain. But it's underwater, where the wealth of animals in Southern Spain reaches its zenith. The protected reserves in the Mediterranean reveal an incomparable variety of species: weird sea slugs of almost alien appearance, graceful sea horses, huge swarms of barracudas and elegant blue sharks all have their habitat here. Spain's south has shaped the identity of the regions inhabitants. The film accompanies a farmer in the Extremadura, Spain's Wild West, as well as a fisherman who operates sustainable fishing off the coast of the Cabo de Gata reserve. Common to both is the fact that neither of them would consider exchanging their homeland for a life in the city. Wild Spain – The Mediterranean South reveals the unknown side of a region that many think they know, but in which there is so much more to discover.

programme.title: Amazing Isfahan
programme.sub-title: Paradise in the Heart of Iran
programme.desc: Take a look at this natural beauty. Isfahan – the Florence of Persia, the blue pearl of Iran. The city in the heart of Iran is the most charismatic city in the country and often uttered in the same breath as Bagdad, Constantinople or Cairo. The former capital of the Persian Safavid Empire has long since lost the status of cosmopolitan city, but it still radiates a cosmopolitan charm of which the inhabitants are extremely proud. With its Iranian and Persian national consciousness, Isfahan emits a form of comeliness that attracts people near and far. Following the 30-year-old carpet dealer Shanty as he tries to establish a business for himself and his fiancée Nina, we discover the soul of the city with mesmeric shots, intimate portraits and true to life portrayals of daily life. For 120 years his family has been dealing with noble Persian carpets, but Shanty dreams of a modern coffee shop, driven by a youthful eagerness to experiment and with passion for the new. In the cozy little espresso bar on the city's famous Imam Square Shanty's barista conjures up the best créma in Isfahan while Pink Floyd, The Grateful Death and Led Zeppelin boom from the loudspeakers nothing new in Berlin or Paris but almost revolutionary here. In intimate pictures, we accompany the youngest son of an old Isfahan family through his bulging everyday life and see how many young Iranians try to unite the culture and traditions of their country with the present.

programme.title: Iceland
programme.desc: Majestic volcanoes, seething geysers, raging waterfalls, threatening fjords, mighty glaciers, endless lava fields – there is hardly another country in the world that offers as much impressive nature as Iceland, the remote island in the harsh North Sea. The nature in Iceland is immense! Here, the four elements of nature can be experienced as raw and as close-up as practically no other place on Earth. And nowhere on the northern hemisphere can the origin of life, can growth and decay be experienced as dramatically as here. Besides the impressive nature, we get to know the dramatic history of the Viking culture with its nature-influenced mythology and discuss the negative effects of excessive tourism.

Among the other 13 highly motivated strongmen, two SCL legends will make their comeback to the competition: Former World Champion of 2015, Krzysztof Radzikowski (Poland) and Dainis Zageris (Latvia).

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The fight for the Finnish trophy continues. programme.title: The Jade Princess
programme.desc: In the wake of an assassination attempt targeting the royal family, the ninja invite the royal princess, HARUMI, into their makeshift family. Lloyd glimpses someone escaping over the rooftops with a sack on their back. Fearing it is the kidnapped princess, Lloyd takes up the chase! He discovers to his surprise, however, that the masked intruder is none other than the princess herself, who is not quite as docile or meek as she pretends. She has a habit of sneaking out of her chambers at night to feed the homeless who surround the Imperial Palace. This revelation only endears her to Lloyd more and Harumi and Lloyd quickly strike up a friendship. Unfortunately, trouble catches up to the ninja when the Sons Of Garmadon target the second Oni mask and attack the palace. The scope of the attack proves more than the Ninja were prepared for as the Sons of Garmadon detonate a series of subterranean bombs, bringing down part of the palace. Lloyd and Harumi escape onto the flying ship, DESTINY'S BOUNTY. But the victory is a pyrrhic one. The second Oni Mask has been stolen and Harumi's parents and Master Hutchins are feared lost.

programme.title: The Pranks
programme.desc: The friends are using their talents to pull a prank on Olivia. But who gets the last laugh?Stephanie finds the perfect front page story for the school paper! It's almost too good to be true. Emma and Andrea go undercover to solve the mystery of the two Jacobs.

programme.title: Andrea's Big Moment
programme.desc: When famous pop star Livi comes to Heartlake City to judge a talent show, our five friends Olivia, Mia, Andrea, Emma and Stephanie all decide to enter – and one of them, in particular, really wants to win but faces some serious challenge from an old rival. A talent show has come to Heartlake City and all the girls enter the talent competition hoping to impress the judges, especially their idol, pop star Chloe. No one wants a shot at stardom more than Andrea, which is why the other girls are surprised when she doesn't show up to practice before the first round of the competition. Very nearly eliminated prior to the big show, Andrea panics and throws herself into an intense practice-training mode, even shutting her friends out when they're trying to help her with her performance. Just moments before her live TV debut, Andrea realizes she's missing a key element to her act. Can she pull it off without her friends? And are the other girls willing to help after being pushed away?

programme.title: Kate's Island
programme.desc: The five friends leave for science camp that takes place on an island and during the trip, they meet the stand-offish Kate – but they soon realize that there's more to her than meets the eyes and that you shouldn't judge the book by its cover. No one is more excited than Olivia about science camp at a beautiful rocky offshore island with a lighthouse. But Olivia quickly gets off on the wrong foot with a mysterious girl named Kate who seems obsessed with a medallion necklace and the island's rumored history of pirates and treasure. Even worse for Olivia, Kate seems to be growing extra chummy with Mia, even sneaking around the island with her late at night. With the help of Stephanie, Emma and Andrea, Olivia is determined to get to the bottom of the girls' secret friendship and find out once and for all what they're searching for on the island, but they better not let Mrs. Stevens catch them out of their cabin past curfew.

programme.title: The Grand Hotel
programme.desc: The five friends help out at The Grand Hotel that Andrea's family just bought during what was supposed to be a quiet weekend until a hotel critic arrives unexpectedly. The girls are ready to do everything to make a great impression – but things don't quite go according to plan. Andrea, Stephanie, Olivia, Emma and Mia have come for breakfast at the fanciest hotel in town, now owned by Andrea's family. When Andrea's aunt has to leave town, the girls volunteer to run the hotel for the weekend with the help of quirky Grandma Jean. This is the perfect job for Stephanie's expert managerial skills but then the hotel suddenly fills to capacity with guests, including a hotel critic that can make or break the hotel's reputation! Now the girls find themselves in over their heads juggling reception, childcare, food prep and waitressing, a dog-walking service and a testy chef who quits on them in the middle of dinner. Unfortunately, much of this is their own fault. Can the girls save the Grand Hotel from themselves?

programme.title: Ninjaball Run
programme.desc: When the ninja learn that Darreth's Mojo Dojo is to be destroyed and Darreth doesn't have the money to save it, our heroes enter the annual NinjaBall Run to win its cash prize in order to save the dojo. As Lloyd continues to train and unlock his hidden powers, the Ninja learn land developers are going to destroy Darreth's Mojo Dojo unless Darreth can find the money to save it. The Ninja decide to enter their Ninja Tank into the annual NinjaBall Run cross-country rally to try to win its cash prize. Revisiting past characters who also enter the race, the high-speed derby will only grow more dangerous as Garmadon enters his Black Bounty, realizing this is the perfect chance to use his Mega-Weapon and rid the ninja. In the end, the Ninja will discover a few secrets within their Ninja Tank, allowing them to beat Garmadon's Bounty by a millisecond and saving Darreth's Dojo with their well-deserved cash prize. And as a final surprise, the Ninja steal back the Destiny's Bounty and make it their own once again.

programme.title: Child's Play
programme.desc: When the Ninja interrupt Lord Garmadon from using his Mega-Weapon to ‘turn back the clock' and bring to life the fossils of a monster, the Ninja are accidentally hit and turned into kids and are now forced to enlist Lloyd's help to battle the awakened monster. Tired of intense training, Lloyd yearns to play and enjoy his youth. The Ninja remind Lloyd that along with great power, comes great responsibility. When the Ninja interrupt Lord Garmadon from using his Mega-Weapon to ‘turn back the clock' and bring to life the fossils of a monster, the Ninja are accidentally hit and soon discover they've been turned into kids! Seeking Lloyd's help and relying on childhood antics, the five ninja kids must destroy the reawakened monster that's hunting them in the city. In the end, Lloyd makes the difficult decision and sacrifices his youth in order to save them from the beast, turning forward the clock and turning Lloyd into a young man. Sensei Wu fears now that since Lloyd is young man, the final battle of good versus evil approaches sooner than he had ever expected.

programme.title: The Surge
programme.desc: After a time of peace, the Ninja are called back into action. The spirit of the defeated Overlord has infected the electric grid of Ninjago and is using all available technology to exact his revenge on Lloyd. Nowhere is safe but fortunately, the Ninja have been given the powerful Techno Blades. But the only problem is that they have no idea how to use them. Time has passed since the Ultimate Battle, and while the Golden Ninja continues to watch over Ninjago, the other Ninja have become complacent as schoolteachers. When a mysterious invitation from genius Cyrus Borg brings them to the futuristic New Ninjago City, trouble surges when a digital virus of the Overlord takes over technology. The Golden Ninja makes a heroic entrance, only to find out his Golden Power supercharges the enemy. Sensei Wu stays behind so that the Ninja can escape with the only thing that can save Ninjago's future – Borg's Techno Weapons.

programme.title: The Art Of The Silent Fist
programme.desc: The Ninja go into hiding but an army of the Digtial Overlord's evil robotic Nindroids are hunting them wherever they go. Their only chance is to learn the secrets of the Techno blades and use them to cut all power to save Ninjao from this technological menace. The Ninja hide out at a safe place void of technology – Sensei Garmadon's Sanctuary. That night, Zane is visited by Borg's female robo-assistant, Pixal. She warns them that the Digital Overlord is after Lloyd's Golden Power in order to become flesh, but the Techno Blades can reboot the system and erase him for good. After a highly advanced army of Nindroids attacks the Sanctuary, Lloyd flees with his father into the wilderness of Ninjago, while the rest set off on a quest to turn off all power in Ninjago, so that they can erase the Digital Overlord once and for all.

programme.title: The Book Of Total Badness
programme.desc: The NEXO-Knights must fight Jestro's Monsters of Destruction which are attacking all over the Kingdom. But Merlok smells a trap…is he right? In a dark, destroyed part of the kingdom, Jestro arrives at the ruins of a HUGE castle. The Book of Monsters knows this place: the great evil wizard Monstrux lived here. The Book sniffs out some powerful magic in the ruins: “The Book of Destruction.” With this, The Book tells Jestro they can destroy the NEXO-Knights and then attack the King's Castle and cause massive destruction. Jestro creates destructive monsters and sends them all over the realm, so the Knights must separate and fight single combats all over the place. The Knights lose these battles (lesson: they have to work as a team!) And, just when the Knights are scattered across the Kingdom, Jestro attacks the King's Castle! It looks like all is lost. When Aaron, who has escaped, returns to see Jestro's attack, he realizes he must gather his fellow Knights. Merlok says it's very dangerous, but Aaron says he must take the risk to gather the Knights and save Knighton.

programme.title: The Might And The Magic
programme.desc: Aaron races across the kingdom to gather the NEXO-Knights as Jestro and his Destructive Monsters attack the King's Castle. The Knights must get back to the capitol in time, or Jestro will rule the kingdom! Jestro, while still attacking the King's Castle, has second thoughts until the Book of Monsters orders the mad jester to feed him another magic book he's found (and has been saving.) It's the powerful “Book of Revenge!” Now, combining the powers of Revenge and Destruction, Jestro and his monsters will get their vengeance on King Halbert and the Kingdom of Knighton. Jestro and his monsters lay siege…will they destroy the castle?! Meanwhile, Aaron races across the Kingdom gathering the NEXO-Knights one at a time. As each Knight rejoins the group, they become a more and more powerful team. They even get Robin to join them as the Black Knight in his repaired power suit. Our Knights arrive, finally regrouped, fight off Jestro, save the castle and the King. It's a glorious victory! The King is so pleased after seeing how the brave NEXO-Knights saved his kingdom, he allows Macy to join them as an official NEXO-Knight.

programme.title: Back To School
programme.desc: When the NEXO-Knights are sloppy in a fight with Jestro, Merlok 2.0 sends them back to the Knights' Academy. Not only for a brush-up but to find out what Jestro is after in its hallowed halls. As they Knights battle Jestro – in a somewhat haphazard and lazy way – they discuss the fact that Jestro never wins and that they're always getting over on him. Despite defeating the jerky Jester and his evil Book, Merlok 2.0 discovers that something about the attack on the village is tied to the Knights' Academy. It looks like that's where they'll strike next. It wouldn't hurt for the Knights to go “back to school” to watch for Jestro and for some refresher training. Merlok is sure Jestro wants something at the Academy, but he doesn't know what it is. The Knights are very much “fish out of water” at the academy, even with the “cool kids” – Robin and Ava – showing them around. The next generation of Knights is being taught to integrate the NEXO-Magic of Merlok into their fighting techniques and these kids are good (so good, they initially kick the lazy, know-it-all Knight's butts!) Their old principal, the ever-ornery Headmaster Brickland, sets them straight: they're all still slackers, and they better get their acts together (especially Lance!) The Knights take shifts as “library helpers” much to the delight of the old squirebot librarian, MARGE. They're convinced Jestro is after a book…isn't he always after a book? When Jestro attacks, the Knights help organize the students and there's a big fight in the Academy Library versus Jestro and his Monsters. They drive Jestro off without letting him steal any books! Victory! But as Jestro leaves, we see him holding what the Book of Monsters really wanted: a snow globe with a castle in it that was sitting on the librarian's desk. In the Lava Lands, Jestro throws the snow globe into a volcano and it frees the massive Castle of Monstrux from its snowy magic prison

programme.title: Greed Is Good?
programme.desc: When Jestro uses the Book of Greed to rob Auremville of its riches, he also gets Lance's parents as prisoners and these demanding rich folks are too much for even monsters to handle. Jestro's not sure what to do with his new castle in the Lava Lands. “Every castle needs a big chamber filled with treasure” says the Book of Monsters so they've got to go out looting! The BOM convinces Jestro to call forth GENERAL MAGMAR, and Jestro appoints him as “general manager” of “castle operations,” much to Magmar's dismay. Meanwhile, Jestro and the BOM find the BOOK OF GREED. This will allow them to make greedy, rapacious monsters that will bring them all the treasure they want to fill their castle! They'll head to the richest town in the realm – AUREMVILLE! Meanwhile, in Auremville, the NEXO-Knights arrive for a huge “Gold is Good” ball at Lance's house. When the Monsters finally arrive in Auremville, a battle breaks out and the greedy monsters make off with everything…including Lance's parents, Goldie and Cuthbert Richmond who are clad in the finest golden garments and so look valuable! Lance will now be forced to live…poor. The Knights have to get his parents back. Meanwhile, his parents – Cuthbert and Goldie Richmond –think their imprisonment in Jestro's gold-filled castle is a “spa holiday” with the worst service. They order Magmar and the monsters around like servants and drive them all crazy. The Knights pile into the Fortrex and head for the Lava Lands, formulating a plan along the way to free Lance's parents. In a village half-way to Jestro's Castle, the Knights run into…Jestro and his monsters headed the other way with Lance's parents and all the gold they've stolen. There's a big fight, until they realize they might have the same goal and decide to deal. The BOM wants to give them back all the gold and Lance's parents. Lance says “No deal.” “We'll take the gold, you can keep my parents.” It's a weird and comical stand-off. Finally, Clay convinces Lance he has to take his parents back even if they don't always get along (and, it's the only way to get the gold back.)

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Once upon a time there was a king. He was very cranky and foolish. One day he wished to taste an exotic fowl and sent Yegor the huntsman to the deep forest. In the forest, Yegor met a starling, which turned into a beautiful girl. The Tsar saw Yegor to have successfully completed his task and also got the beautiful wife. He started to envy Yegor. The Tsar decided to send Yegor over distant seas to bring do not know what. Despite Tsar's insidious plan, Yegor has successfully returned back home and even taught the king an important lesson not to envy other people.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: There lived a Tsar with his three sons. The oldest son married on nobleman's daughter, the second one married the merchant's daughter, while the youngest son - on the Frog. She was not pretty, but happened to be the Frog Princess who turned into a beautiful girl. This story teaches us to take care of your pets. This is the only way they could appeal to your concerns and become your faithful friends.

One day a strange dwarf came to Caliph. He promised to help him to turn him into a stork. Caliph agreed and turned into a stork. Meanwhile, the dwarf sat on the throne and proclaimed himself Caliph. At night, when Jack and his mother were sleeping, the seed sprouted and grew into a tall tree. In the morning, Jack has decided to climb this tree. He attempted several times but each time he fell down. Suddenly he noticed a saw a plait hanging next to him from the tree. He pulled it down and suddenly a beautiful girl fell right into his arms. They got married and lived happily ever after. To conclude, only selfless deeds can bring true happiness.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Sulakshana and Indravadhan engage into a conversation where the latter tells the former about his love for her. When Indravadhan turns around, he is flabbergasted seeing Sulakshana's state. Later, Badi Raani Maa tells Indravadhan that Sulakshana has cut her wrist because she was emotionally hurt. programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani

Badi Raani Maa then narrates the story of her life and reveals that she was her husband's second wife. She tells Kuwar Singh that she would not let Indravadhan extend his rule on the Ameerkot. It is also revealed that it was Badi Raani, who hired a woman to act as Sulakshana. What more plans is Badi Raani Maa going to plot against Gayatri? Keep watching the captivating episode of 'Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Raani' to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Gayatri confronts Sulakshana and apologizes to her for interfering in her and Indravadhan's life. Sulakshana claims that Gayatri would now be her slave and work for her. Hearing this, Indravadhan and Raj Mata are flabbergasted. Indravadhan shouts at Sulakshana and claims that Gayatri is his wife. Gayatri replies to Indravadhan saying that she is his second wife. Will Gayatri agree to be Sulakshana's slave? Keep watching the enrapturing episode of 'Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Raani' to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani

On the other hand, Raj Mata is all set to teach Sulakshana a lesson but her plans fail as Badi Raani Maa locks her in a room. What are Raj Mata's real intentions? Keep watching the captivating episode of 'Ek Tha Raaja Ek Thi Raani' to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Indravadhan gets furious with Sulakshana and tells her that Gayatri too is his wife. He adds on that he cannot bear this kind of insult thrown on Gayatri. programme.title: DO CHUTKI SINDOOR
programme.desc: Vinayak and Siddhi live in Agra and Siddhi has a sister named Maya, who has a mental capacity of a 9-year-old. Siddhi takes full responsibility of Maya and ensures she is never left alone. Sunaina, their stepmother worries about Maya. Siddhi assures Sunaina that she will not marry until she finds someone who will take care of Maya. On the other hand, Vinayak who is the only son of rich and famous Jayadevi, a shrewd woman who despises the colour black. Vinayak and Siddhi's paths cross when Maya is about to get hit by Vinayak's car. Siddhi intervenes and saves Maya, but in anger slaps Vinayak for calling Maya "Pagal" (crazy). Vinayak realizes that he has fallen for Siddhi and promises to take care of Maya and marries Siddhi to seek revenge and make Maya suffer.

programme.title: PAAPNAASHNI GANGA

The Reason Behind Ganga'S Birth Was To Destruct Evil Entities. The Powers Of Adishakti Made Mainavati Give Birth To A Female Child Who Became Known As Ganga. Devatas Considered Ganga'S Purity As A Weapon Which Could Destroy Evil Asuras. As A Humble & Virtuous Woman, Ganga'S Entire Life Was Full Of Hardships, Which She Led Washing Away The Sins Of All Of Humanity Without Any Discrimination. Ganga Had Sacrificed All Her Desires On The Altar Of Dharma And Led A Divine Life Full Of Welfare Of Humanity. The Show Is Visually Appealing With Strong Vfx Which Will Enhance The Viewers Experience.

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is the duo HOONS! HOONS is composed of two musicians of the same age - vocalist Lee Sang-hoon and keyboardist Lee Jong-hoon. They met each other in university and then made their debut together in 2016 with the single To You I Am. Thanks to their soft mellow music and sweet lyrics the duo mesmerized the public immediately and they are certainly making their way in the music industry building their fanbase and having their music featured in various TV shows. In this episode HOONS performs I C U Can't hide a love and many others to showcase the essence of their musicality. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet the duo!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is the Korean father of city pop - Kim Hyun-chul! Kim Hyun-chul made his debut in 1989 with the album Kim Hyun-chul Vol. 1. With all songs composed written and arranged by the artist himself he pleasantly surprised the ears and souls of listeners with his jazz-infused music and eventually brought a new wave to the Korean music scene. Throughout his 32-year career Kim Hyun-chul gained much critical acclaim and commercial success earning the nickname the father of Korean city pop. Also his debut album was chosen as one of the All-Time 100 Greatest Albums of Korean Popular Music thanks to the influence it had had on the Korean music scene. Then in 2019 Kim Hyun-chul resumed his career after a break of 13 years and in celebration of the 30th anniversary of his debut. The album garnered much attention not only because of the anticipation of fans and critics but also because he brought an array of Korea's leading artists along with him. His return coincided with the resurgence of city pop in Korea and he's back once again 2 years later in 2021 to continue with the momentum. Part I of Kim Hyun-chul's performance on I'm LIVE features What's the Matter? City Breeze & Love Song and Tears of Joy. Tune in to the show and meet the legend!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is top-notch singer Jung yup! Jung yup made his debut in 2003 as a member of the R&B group Brown Eyed Soul. Composed of four highly talented vocalists the group impressed the ears and souls of the public immediately. Then in 2007 Jung yup performed the song Nothing Better at one concert which went viral on the internet and attracted a lot of attention laying the foundation for his popularity. After a long long break this artist announced his much-anticipated return in April this year. Since then he has released two singles full of love and romance Waltz For You and DRIVE to melt listeners' hearts once again. In this episode Jung yup performs his new songs Waltz For You and DRIVE his all-time greatest hit Nothing Better and more. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this wonderful vocalist!

programme.title: INDIPEDIA

programme.title: RAJA RASOI AUR ANDAAZ ANOKHA
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel's Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery both personal and culinary. Ranveer's passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: REGIMENT DIARIES
programme.desc: The Indian Army is an emotion – a living chronicle of events, that we have the luxury to forget because they remember. The army itself is a family of several regiments, each of which has its own history, identity, and glorious traditions. Regiment Diaries is a tale of the Indian Army unlike any told before. Told by the very men who follow the illustrious feats of their predecessors, it tells timeless tales that warm the heart, moisten the eye, and leave you in awe of the bravest children of India.

programme.title: New 2023 Range Rover Sport Design Reveal Film
programme.desc: The New Range Rover Sport has made its global premiere with a dramatic world-first climb up a flooded dam spillway in Iceland. The epic ascent saw New Range Rover Sport resist the surging torrent of water flowing down the ramp of the Karahnjukar Dam – the biggest of its kind in the world – at a rate of 750 tonnes per minute. A loss of traction risked plunging down the perilous 90m drop at the base of the spillway to the valley floor below. The successful spillway ascent was screened for the first time at an exclusive launch event at Jaguar Land Rover's Advanced Product Creation Centre at Gaydon, UK. Official James Bond stunt driver Jessica Hawkins was behind the wheel as the New Range Rover Sport demonstrated its grip, traction, performance and composure, completing the latest in a series of challenges for Land Rover's luxury performance SUV. Previous feats include a record-setting hill-climb at Pikes Peak, a first recorded crossing of the ‘Empty Quarter' desert in the Arabian Peninsula and a first ascent of the 999 steps to Heaven's Gate in China, in 2018.

programme.title: Hispano Suiza showcases its history in the Peralada Castle Museum
programme.desc: The history of Hispano Suiza is showcased, for the very first time, in the Peralada Castle Museum (Girona, Spain) where visitors will be able to contemplate the past and present of the legendary car brand founded in 1904 by Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt. The Hispano Suiza Room will close the usual tour of the Peralada Castle Museum. After years of researching to gather the largest number of pieces and objects related to its history, Hispano Suiza becomes part of this important collection. The Hispano Suiza exhibition encompasses a journey through various decades: from the beginning of the 20th century, when Hispano Suiza was founded, to the present day. After passing through a luxurious hall, the public will be able to visit a recreation of the offices of Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt, where countless business and technical ideas, emerged and took shape, turning Hispano Suiza into a point of reference, for luxury, comfort and technical solutions. In this area, the original painting 'Dame with a mink' by Ramon Casas takes pride of place: it was used as an illustration on the company's original shares.

programme.title: TechDay Digital Light
programme.desc: Safety and customer satisfaction come first at Audi. They are part and parcel of the success of the company with the four rings. In that context, light technology is steadily growing more important and creating a wider range of possibilities and perspectives, from added safety for the driver, to external communication and individualization. Systematic light digitization is making all of this possible. It is particularly visible in the new Audi A8: the forward-looking Digital Matrix LED headlights and digital OLED rear lights raise the customer experience to a whole new level: for the first time in any Audi model, light is completely digitized. The car can be individualized even further through its digital OLED rear lights. The Digital Matrix LED headlights also include three new functions: advanced traffic information, a lane light with direction indicator lights on highways, and an orientation light on country roads. These features not only demonstrate Audi's “Vorsprung durch Technik,” they also add value.

programme.title: Mercedes-Benz DRIVE PILOT Sensors S-Class
programme.desc: The exact location of a Mercedes equipped with DRIVE PILOT is determined using a high-precision positioning system that is much more powerful than conventional GPS systems. In addition to the anonymised data collected by LiDAR, camera, radar and ultrasound sensors, a digital HD map provides a three-dimensional image of the road and the surroundings with information on road geometry, route characteristics, traffic signs and special traffic events (e.g. accidents or road works). This high-precision map differs from maps for navigation devices by, among other things, its higher accuracy in the centimetre rather than metre range and its detailed junction and route model. The map data is stored in backend data centres and updated constantly. Each vehicle also stores an image of this map information on board, constantly compares it with the backend data and updates the local dataset as required. All of this enables stable and accurate positioning through a representation of the surroundings that is independent of factors such as shadows or dirty sensors.

programme.title: Kia Sportage Exterior Design in Lunar Silver
programme.desc: A number of new technologies optimize the precision and control of the chassis in a wide variety of weather and road conditions. The standard electronic damper control (Electronic Control Suspension, ECS) in the GT-line version increases comfort and safety thanks to the continuous damping control. The system reacts to body movements and steering inputs and changes the damping behavior at lightning speed in order to counteract the vehicle's diving, pitching and rolling movements when cornering. It also adjusts the damping force in the case of obstacles in order to cope with them as comfortably as possible and to reduce the influence of post-vibrations on the wheels. A premiere for the Sportage is the “All-Terrain-Mode”, which will be available for the plug-in hybrid version with all-wheel drive. The system offers intelligent support when driving off-road or on snow by automatically optimizing the vehicle settings depending on the selected mode and thus helping the SUV to achieve maximum traction on muddy, sandy or snowy surfaces.

programme.title: The new Mercedes-Benz GLC AMG Line World Premiere Teaser
programme.desc: The new GLC is immediately recognisable as a member of the Mercedes-Benz SUV family. Standard equipment includes the AVANTGARDE exterior with Chrome package including chrome window surrounds and a new, chrome-look simulated underguard. This adds striking design features and enhances the unique proportions of the vehicle. One of the defining design highlights of the GLC is the redesigned front end, with headlamps that connect directly to the radiator grille to emphasise the vehicle's width, and the new radiator grille as part of the standard AVANTGARDE exterior, which now has a chrome surround and a sporty louvre in matt grey with chrome trim. The AMG Line has a radiator grille with Mercedes-Benz pattern. The body design is characterised by a full, spanned surface design enriched with precisely shaped edges in the sides. These emphasise the proportions, accentuate the muscular wheel arches and create a balance between elegance and off-road performance. Wheel arch liners in the vehicle colour are available from the AMG Line upwards for the first time. These accentuate the sportiness of the AMG Line, as optional equipment in conjunction with mixed tyres. Also available as an optional extra are easy-entry running boards and, from the AMG Line upwards, a Night package.

Quello che sembra essere solo un casuale incidente, nasconde in realtà un segreto ben più inquietante.

programme.title: Un lupo mannaro americano a Parigi
programme.desc: Appena diplomati, Andy, Chris e Brad, decidono di fare un viaggio in Europa e arrivano a Parigi. Durante la loro prima sera, salgono sulla torre Eiffel e uno di loro decide di lanciarsi, legandosi ad una corda elastica. All'improvviso appare ai suoi occhi una ragazza che sta per suicidarsi... La ragazza, in realtà, è una licantropa che oltre ad innamorarsi, lo infetta con un morso...

programme.title: The Thaw
programme.desc: Una spedizione scientifica nell'Artico scopre che lo scioglimento dei ghiacci ha liberato un parassita preistorico letale. Quando il contagio esplode nel campo di ricerca, un gruppo di studenti resta isolato e deve impedire che l'organismo raggiunga il resto del mondo.

programme.title: LARS E UNA RAGAZZA TUTTA SUA
programme.desc: Lars è un uomo estremamente timido e isolato che sorprende tutti presentando una bambola come la propria fidanzata. La comunità sceglie di assecondarlo in un percorso inatteso di crescita e guarigione emotiva.

programme.title: SCANDALO AL COLLEGE
programme.desc: Annie e Katie sono migliori amiche da sempre e il loro sogno è quello di frequentare il college di Pine State. Il loro sogno, però, deve scontrarsi con la realtà: non hanno i voti abbastanza alti per entrare in graduatoria. Qui parte il piano di riscatto, sono pronte a tutto pur di entrare perfino pagare altri per sostenere l'esame al posto loro. Quella che, però, sembra una semplice truffa d'identità, in realtà, si trasforma ben presto in un incubo con tanto di uccisioni e vite messe in pericolo.

programme.title: Regali da uno Sconosciuto

Il recente matrimonio tra Simon e Robyn viene sconvolto da un incontro casuale con un conoscente dell'uomo. Un segreto orribile del passato di Simon farà nascere in Robyn il dubbio su quanto realmente conosca il marito e il suo passato.

programme.title: UNA VICINA QUASI PERFETTA

programme.title: Zanna Bianca

programme.title: Free birds

Gli fa credere di esser stato coinvolto in un omicidio e fa in modo di sottrargli una grossa quantità di denaro. L'attuazione del piano, però, non sarà affatto semplice.

programme.title: Panarea
programme.desc: Divertenti storie intrecciate in un fine settimana estivo a Panarea, la più piccola delle isole Eolie: Enrico cerca di sedurre la bella Maria ma è costantemente intralciato dalla sorellina Claudia, i due amici Riccardo e Luca scommettono su chi dei due farà colpo su Alessandra, un ragazzo rimasto da solo organizza una festa nella villa dei genitori.

programme.title: L'ultimo giorno del toro
programme.desc: L'ultimo giorno del toro è una commedia sul male di vivere, sulla paura di affrontare la vita a viso aperto, sull'incomunicabilità, sui silenzi ingoiati dalle troppe parole di un'epoca forse un po' troppo piena di significanti privi di significato.

programme.title: Black Bits
programme.desc: Aggirare e derubare la Black Bits, società attiva nel dark web, sembrava un'impresa impossibile che Dora e Beth hanno però portato a termine. Adesso sono in possesso di due neurochip di ultima generazione dall'inestimabile valore e si nascondono in una futuristica 'safe house' lontana dal resto del mondo.

programme.title: I Due Orfanelli
programme.desc: Due poveri amici cresciuti insieme vengono travolti da equivoci, scambi d'identità e inattese rivelazioni sulle proprie origini. Tra nobili, boia e fortune capovolte, Totò guida una farsesca avventura in costume.

programme.title: Ci troviamo in galleria
programme.desc: Grande classico del cinema italiano con Sophia Loren e Alberto Sordi. Carlo, in arte "Gardenio", artista di varietà non più giovane, ha per anni cercato inutilmente il successo, ed ora, per vivere, organizza giri in provincia con una compagnia di artisti da strapazzo. Nel corso di uno spettacolo, in un piccolo paese di montagna, accade qualcosa di speciale.

programme.title: Bello, onesto, emigrato Australia sposerebbe compaesana illibata
programme.desc: Un emigrato italiano in Australia cerca moglie tramite corrispondenza e conosce Carmela. Entrambi hanno abbellito la propria realtà: quando finalmente si incontrano, menzogne e pregiudizi lasciano spazio a un rapporto inatteso.

programme.title: Il Magnifico Cornuto
programme.desc: Andrea ama profondamente la moglie Maria Grazia, ma un dubbio sulla sua fedeltà diventa un'ossessione. La gelosia lo spinge a pedinarla e a interpretare ogni gesto come una prova del tradimento, fino alla paranoia.

programme.title: Una giornata particolare
programme.desc: 6 maggio 1938. La Roma fascista è in festa per l`arrivo del Fuhrer in visita dal Duce. In un angolo di Roma più lontano dai fasti, in un edificio popolare, Antonietta, casalinga madre di sei figli, cresciuta nel culto del Duce, incontra casualmente per la prima volta il suo vicino di casa, Gabriele, ex annunciatore radiofonico omosessuale e prossimo al confino. Dopo la diffidenza iniziale, il loro rapporto si trasforma in affetto e comprensione...

programme.title: Ieri, oggi e domani
programme.desc: Trio di novelle, tre ritratti di donna che si avvalgono dell`eclettico brio interpretativo di Sophia Loren. Da un soggetto di Eduardo De Filippo: "Adelina", napoletana che vende sigarette di contrabbando e, per evitare il carcere, sforna figli a ripetizione da una novella di Aberto Moravia: "Anna", ricca milanese che, per noia, tradisce il marito con un giovane intellettuale squattrinato da un soggetto di Cesare Zavattini: "Mara", squillo d`alto bordo che fa invaghire un giovane seminarista.

programme.title: Matrimonio all'italiana
programme.desc: Dopo essere stata domestica e amante del ricco Domenico, Filumena, fingendosi in punto di morte, riesce a farsi sposare. L`inganno però viene scoperto e Domenico è risoluto a sciogliere il matrimonio, ma Filumena non si arrende e cos gli rivela di avere tre figli, uno dei quali suo...

programme.title: Splendor
programme.desc: Il proprietario, il proiezionista e la maschera di una sala di provincia che sta per chiudere i battenti si abbandonano ai ricordi: ma quando gli operai stanno già schiodando le poltrone...

programme.title: The Constant Gardener
programme.desc: Quando sua moglie Tessa viene trovata morta in Kenya, il diplomatico Justin Quayle inizia a indagare, scoprendo una rete di corruzione e segreti pericolosi. Tra intrighi politici e complotti farmaceutici, la sua ricerca della verità metterà a rischio la sua stessa vita.

programme.title: Prima danza e poi pensa

programme.title: Un padre, una figlia

Quando Eliza vince una borsa di studio, la sua vita sembra finalmente prendere il volo. Ma l'aggressione che subisce il giorno prima dell'esame di ammissione in Regno Unito metterà a dura prova le sue scelte e i valori che ha sempre trasmesso alla figlia.

programme.title: Final Portrait
programme.desc: Nel 1964, durante un breve viaggio a Parigi, lo scrittore americano e appassionato d'arte James Lord incontra il suo amico Alberto Giacometti, un pittore di fama internazionale, che gli chiede di posare per lui. Le sedute, gli assicura Giacometti, dureranno solo qualche giorno. Lusingato e incuriosito, Lord accetta. Non è solo l'inizio di un'amicizia insolita e toccante, ma anche di un viaggio illuminante nella bellezza, la frustrazione, la profondità e, a volte, il vero e proprio caos del processo artistico.

programme.title: I complessi

programme.title: Il silenzio del testimone

programme.desc: Bello e arrogante, Kyle viene trasformato in un “mostro”. Solo l'amore vero potrà salvarlo. Una favola dark dove l'apparenza non conta più.

programme.title: Double Whammy
programme.desc: Un detective di polizia disilluso, che non riesce a impedire una strage in un fast food, lotta per riconquistare la reputazione all'interno del dipartimento, l'immagine pubblica e la propria autostima.

programme.title: Tutta colpa di Sara
programme.desc: Divertente commedia on the road, con Matthew Perry e la bellissima Elizabeth Hurley. L'ufficiale giudiziario Joe si guadagna da vivere inventandosi gli espedienti più ingegnosi per inviare avvisi di garanzia a chiunque entri nel suo mirino. Sara, allevatrice di bestiame in Texas, è uno dei suoi bersagli. Con l'aiuto di Gordon, socio di Sara che cerca di arricchirsi, Joe prova ad incastrarla.

programme.title: Ti presento Bill
programme.desc: Stufo del suo lavoro, di sua moglie e della sua vita, Bill si ritrova mentore di un adolescente indisciplinato ma curiosamente saggio. La vita di Bill crolla quando sorprende la moglie ad avere una relazione con un conduttore televisivo. Non avendo più nulla da perdere, si rivolge al ragazzo come modello d'ispirazione, e riprende in mano le redini della sua vita.

programme.title: The land girls – Ragazze di campagna
programme.desc: Durante la Seconda Guerra Mondiale, le donne inglesi vengono reclutate per essere mandate a lavorare nei campi al posto degli uomini diretti al fronte. Ag - interpretata dal premio Oscar Rachel Weisz -, Stella e Prue, tre donne provenienti da ambienti sociali diversi, si ritrovano quindi a vivere in una fattoria sperduta. Qui, l'incontro con l'affascinante Joe cambierà per sempre la loro vita.

programme.title: Cooking Up Love
programme.desc: Per gioco, Zoey affitta un camioncino e partecipa a un concorso televisivo. Tra lei e l'affascinante fondatore di una catena di fast food si scatena il finimondo, ma quando Zoey scopre che lui è un giudice del concorso, le cose precipitano rapidamente. Zoey è determinata a vincere lealmente e sospetta che il signor Troppo Buono per Essere Vero voglia la sua ricetta per la salsa, non il suo cuore.

programme.title: Ridatemi mia figlia
programme.desc: Dopo la scomparsa della figlia a seguito del successo dell'apertura del suo ristorante, Eve decide di prendere in mano la situazione e scoprire chi c'è dietro al rapimento.

programme.title: Alvin Superstar
programme.desc: Tre scoiattoli musicisti vengono scoperti da un aspirante cantautore e vogliono diventare famosi usando le loro incredibili capacità di canto.

programme.title: Alvin Superstar 2
programme.desc: Il famoso trio di scoiattoli preadolescenti di fama mondiale torna a fare i conti con le pressioni della scuola, delle celebrità e di un gruppo musicale femminile rivale noto come The Chipettes.

programme.title: Words and Pictures
programme.desc: Nel disperato tentativo di ottenere l apprezzamento dei suoi allievi, Jack escogita un piano che prevede una sfida con Dina e i suoi alunni per dimostrare, con una competizione, cosa sia pi utile o importante tra le parole e le immagini.

programme.title: Le ragazze di Piazza di Spagna
programme.desc: Tre ragazze di estrazione popolare lavorano come sarte presso un'importante casa di moda romana. Il loro obiettivo è quello di sposarsi e il lavoro è solo un mezzo per ottenere la dote nel modo più veloce possibile.

programme.title: Una pasticceria da amare
programme.desc: Jessie Dale è una pasticcera di terza generazione che ama la sua pasticceria più di ogni altra cosa al mondo. Quando dei costruttori minacciano di acquistare il suo edificio costringendola ad andarsene, dovrà fare tutto il possibile per salvare la sua pasticceria.

programme.title: Un matrimonio movimentato
programme.desc: Darcy, una organizzatrice di eventi, torna nella sua città natale per organizzare il matrimonio della madre. Tuttavia fa fatica ad accettare il futuro patrigno e ben presto la sua ossessione per la perfezione inizia a scontrarsi con il desiderio della madre di organizzare una cerimonia sobria.

programme.title: Amore inaspettato
programme.desc: Bill, scrittore di successo, resta cieco a causa di un incidente stradale, nel quale sua moglie perde la vita. Un giorno si presenta alla sua porta Suzanne, obbligata ai servizi sociali a causa di una condanna penale. All'inizio i due non si piacciono, ma ben presto si scopriranno innamorati.

programme.title: Pushing Tin
programme.desc: Nick Falzone è il numero uno dei controllori del traffico aereo, finché un tranquillo sconosciuto, Russell Bell, non viene trasferito nel dipartimento. La rivalità tra i due migliori controllori del traffico aereo del TRACON di New York sale a un livello potenzialmente pericoloso.

programme.title: The idol
programme.desc: Siamo a Gaza. Sinonimo di tanti conflitti, distruzione e disperazione, ma per Mohammed Assaf e sua sorella Nour, Gaza è la loro casa e il loro parco giochi. E' dove, insieme ai loro migliori amici Ahmad e Omar, fanno musica, giocano a calcio e hanno il coraggio di sognare in grande.

programme.title: Futura
programme.desc: Louis è un jazzista di talento che ha ormai dimenticato i suoi sogni e vive a distanza le relazioni umane.

programme.title: Amore tra le vigne
programme.desc: Quando la scrittrice della rivista di Seattle Samantha Hart viene mandata a casa per scrivere un articolo sul matrimonio destinazione Hawthorne Vineyards, scopre che l'ex che le ha spezzato il cuore non solo gestisce il vigneto, ma sta per sposarsi lì.

programme.title: Un Natale di ricordi
programme.desc: Con l'avvicinarsi del Natale, Darcy e Aiden sono rattristati dall'imminente chiusura del centro ricreativo della loro comunità. Per salvare il loro amato centro, e con esso lo spirito natalizio, Darcy e Aiden intraprendono un magico viaggio di amore e felicità, dove un ospite inaspettato unisce tutti per una vacanza indimenticabile.

programme.title: Lamore non basta
programme.desc: Martina è un'assistente di volo. Durante un volo conosce Angelo, un ragazzo timido e introverso che come lei vive in un piccolo paese dell'Abruzzo. Scopriranno invece di conoscersi da molto tempo.

programme.title: Un amore a gonfie vele
programme.desc: Quando Lorelei eredita una barca a vela da un parente, assume Rob per aiutarla a ripararla e farla navigare dalla sua posizione attuale su un'isola dei Caraibi a Miami. I due dovranno lavorare insieme mentre le scintille romantiche iniziano a volare.

programme.title: Una dolce occasione
programme.desc: Dopo aver ereditato The Merry & Bright Candy Cane Kitchen di sua nonna, Kate Bracwell assume lo specialista in recupero aziendale Gabe Sumner per aiutarla a migliorare l'azienda. Ma non è tutto semplice Gabe è un cinico del Natale e Kate trova difficile accettare il cambiamento, ma mentre lavorano insieme e riscoprono la magia del Natale, l'amore sboccia.

programme.title: Passioni e Desideri
programme.desc: Con un grande cast, girato tra Vienna, Londra, Parigi, New York, l'Arizona e Rio de Janeiro, il film racconta quanti incontri, opportunità, scelte e decisioni ci si presentano nel corso di una vita.

programme.title: Il gabbiano
programme.desc: Nella casa di campagna dell'anziano Sorin giungono sua sorella Irina, un'attrice famosa, accompagnata dall'amante Boris, uno scrittore di successo. Il figlio di Irina, Konstantin, aspira a diventare un drammaturgo.

programme.title: Ithaca
programme.desc: Primavera del 1942. Dopo la partenza del fratello per il fronte, Homer Macauley, 14 anni, è determinato a diventare il più veloce portalettere dell'ufficio del telegrafo così da poter mantenere la sua numerosa famiglia. E così, mentre sull'isola di Ithaca la primavera lascia il posto all'estate, il giovane Homer passa le sue giornata a recapitare messaggi d'amore e di speranza ma anche di dolore e morte, finché anche lui non riceverà un messaggio che gli cambierà la vita per sempre

programme.title: Fuggiamo insieme
programme.desc: Quando una ragazza appena sposata scopre che suo marito è un nazista, lo lascia e scappa con un giornalista radiofonico che si innamora di lei mentre la segue alla ricerca di una storia su suo marito.

programme.title: The Girl in the Book
programme.desc: Alice Harvey, ventinovenne assistente editor e aspirante scrittrice, è divertente, intelligente ed emotivamente autodistruttiva. Scalando le fila di una importante casa editrice, si sforza di scrivere la propria storia da sempre ostacolata dai ricordi della sua relazione giovanile con Milan, il miglior amico di suo padre. Dopo 15 anni, i percorsi di Alice e Milan si incrociano ancora una volta, costringendo i due a confrontarsi con eventi che sono ormai lontani.

programme.title: La Sorgente dell'Amore
programme.desc: Leila, giovane sposa magrebina, propone alle donne del suo villaggio di fare lo sciopero dell'amore: niente più sesso finché gli uomini non porteranno l'acqua al villaggio. E alla fine le donne la spunteranno.

programme.title: Ladre per caso
programme.desc: L'introversa Carole e la ribelle Caroline hanno in comune solo il padre Patrick, un ladro internazionale ricercato ovunque. Intenzionato a rubare uno «stradivari», Patrick chiederà aiuto alle due figlie, tentando di recuperare il tempo perduto.

programme.title: Parlami Di Te
programme.desc: Alain è un uomo d'affari che non concede alcuno spazio alle distrazioni e alla famiglia. Viene colpito da un ictus, che gli lascia una grave difficoltà nell'espressione verbale e una perdita della memoria. Si affida a una giovane logopedista.

programme.title: Rams
programme.desc: In una valle islandese isolata, Gummi e Kiddiley vivono fianco a fianco, badando al gregge di famiglia, considerato uno dei migliori del paese. I due fratelli vengono spesso premiati per le loro preziose pecore appartenenti a un ceppo antichissimo. Benché dividano la terra e conducano la stessa vita, Gummi e Kiddi non si parlano da quarant'anni. Quando una malattia letale colpisce il gregge di Kiddi, minacciando l'intera vallata, le autorità decidono di abbattere tutti gli animali della zona per contenere l'epidemia.

programme.title: Ricomincio Da Capo
programme.desc: Bloccato dalla neve in Pennsylvania, per il suo rituale servizio sul “giorno della marmotta”, il metereologo televisivo Phil Connors (Bill Murray) si ritrova fermo nel tempo, costretto a rivivere il 2 febbraio.

programme.title: La Squadra Più Scassata Della Lega
programme.desc: La nuova proprietaria dei Cleveland Indians forma una squadra orribile per poterla spostare.

programme.title: Monster House
programme.desc: Michael Newman è sposato con la bellissima Donna e ha due bambini che non riesce a vedere molto a causa del lavoro. Alla ricerca del telecomando perfetto, Michael finisce nel retro di un negozio, il cui commesso gli dà un nuovo telecomando che cambierà la sua vita: oltre ad accendere ogni tipo di apparecchio con un clic, ha anche altre sorprendenti funzioni.

programme.title: Monster House
programme.desc: Michael Newman è sposato con la bellissima Donna e ha due bambini che non riesce a vedere molto a causa del lavoro. Alla ricerca del telecomando perfetto, Michael finisce nel retro di un negozio, il cui commesso gli dà un nuovo telecomando che cambierà la sua vita: oltre ad accendere ogni tipo di apparecchio con un clic, ha anche altre sorprendenti funzioni.

programme.title: I due crociati
programme.desc: Ciccio e Franco, disastri tra Crociati e Saraceni, rovesciano per caso le sorti dello scontro finale.

programme.title: Il ras del quartiere
programme.desc: Domingo, capo di teppisti e custodi del quartiere, aiuta un uomo a cercare la figlia scappata di casa

programme.title: Oh dolci baci e languide carezze
programme.desc: Un ingegnere si invaghisce di una hippy, finisce denunciato per droga e accusato di sedurre due minorenni

programme.title: Le piacevoli notti di Justine
programme.desc: Nell'Ottocento, due attori girovaghi aprono un locale equivoco, sfidano il governatore

programme.title: Anni difficili
programme.desc: Con Umberto Spadaro, Massimo Girotti e Ave Ninchi, Aldo Piscitello deve aderire al Partito Fascista e affrontare la guerra. Tra doveri familiari e scelte morali, cerca il coraggio di restare fedele a sé stesso in un'Italia in crisi.

programme.title: Totò cerca casa
programme.desc: Totò è un uomo alla ricerca disperata di una casa, ma si trova coinvolto in una serie di situazioni esilaranti e complicate. Tra inganni e malintesi, il film esplora con ironia le difficoltà della vita quotidiana.

programme.title: I tartassati
programme.desc: Totò e Aldo Fabrizi, alle prese con le difficoltà quotidiane, affrontano la burocrazia e le complicazioni fiscali con una serie di disavventure comiche e situazioni paradossali, esplorando con ironia le difficoltà della vita moderna.

programme.title: Vita da cani
programme.desc: Le vite di diversi personaggi si intrecciano in un susseguirsi di difficoltà quotidiane e situazioni comiche. Aldo Fabrizi, Gina Lollobrigida e Marcello Mastroianni sono protagonisti di una commedia che racconta le piccole disavventure della vita, con ironia e causticità.

programme.title: First Daughter
programme.desc: La figlia del presidente va al college, ma i pericoli del suo titolo la seguono.

programme.title: The Hoax
programme.desc: Lo scrittore Clifford Irving (Richard Gere) cerca una storia per dare una svolta alla sua carriera in picchiata.. Con l'aiuto dell'amico Dick Suskind (Alfred Molina), convince il suo editore di essere diventato amico intimo del leggendario miliardario eccentrico Howard Hughes.

programme.title: Il club delle mamme single
programme.desc: Quando cinque mamme single in difficoltà mettono da parte le loro differenze per formare un gruppo di sostegno, trovano ispirazione e allegria nella loro nuova associazione e si aiutano a vicenda per superare gli imprevisti che ostacolano il loro cammino.

programme.title: La mia super ex-ragazza
programme.desc: “La mia super ex-ragazza” segue le vicissitudini di Matt Saunders (Luke Wilson), un uomo ordinario, che lascia la sua storica fidanzata (Uma Thurman) – e scopre molto presto che è una supereroina ora in cerca di vendetta.

programme.title: Niente Di Grave, Suo Marito E Incinto
programme.desc: Marco vive a Parigi con Irene. Lei è parrucchiera, lui gestisce una scuola guida. Tutto è tranquillo finché lui non avverte strani disturbi. La diagnosi è incredibile: l'uomo è al quarto mese di gravidanza! La notizia non può che fare il giro del mondo.

programme.title: Another Happy Day
programme.desc: Alla vigilia del matrimonio di suo figlio, Lynn, una donna che ha sempre nascosto le sue emozioni, insieme ai suoi tre figli dovrà fare i conti con le montagne russe emotive di una riunione di famiglia. Una commedia oscura con Ellen Barkin e Demi Moore.

programme.title: Istruzioni non incluse
programme.desc: Valentin è un playboy di Acapulco. Un giorno sulla sua porta viene lasciata una bambina e l'uomo decide di crescerla come fosse sua, cambiando così stile di vita ed arrivando a conquistare Hollywood come stuntman.

programme.title: Il monaco di Monza
programme.desc: Italia, 1630. Totò è un ciabattino alle prese con la miseria e la fame, e padre di famiglia con dodici bambini a carico. Si finge frate assieme a Mamozio e insieme giungono al castello del perfido marchese Egidio de Lattanzis.

programme.title: I Pirati della Malesia
programme.desc: Tra esotiche terre d'Oriente, il leggendario Sandokan guida i suoi uomini contro il dominio coloniale, tra battaglie navali e avventure senza sosta. Diretto da Umberto Lenzi, con Steve Reeves.

programme.title: Il Terrore dei Mari
programme.desc: Tra arrembaggi e inseguimenti nei mari tropicali, un audace pirata sfida flotte nemiche e tradimenti per conquistare libertà e tesori. Un'avventura ricca di azione e colpi di scena, firmata da Domenico Paolella.

programme.title: I Cavalieri del Diavolo
programme.desc: Tra guerre e intrighi, un gruppo di valorosi cavalieri affronta nemici e tradimenti in una lotta per l'onore e la giustizia.

programme.title: I leoni di Pietroburgo
programme.desc: Eldar Kan combatte in difesa degli oppressi, mettendo in difficoltà i nobili, tra cui due che non riescono a unire in matrimonio i rispettivi figli, così rapiscono la ragazza di Eldar Kan, Tamila. Liberata Tamila, Eldar Kan è sfidato a duello da Pavel, imprigiona Anastasia e viene imprigionato a sua volta dai cosacchi. Sarebbe condannato a morte, se Pavel non lo riconoscesse come nobile.

programme.title: I cento cavalieri
programme.desc: Uno dei più bei film storici con il grande Gastone Moschin. Intorno all'anno mille, un gruppo di islamici si insedia in un villaggio della Castiglia. Molto presto, però, il pretesto pacifico con cui si erano introdotti si rivela una farsa: gli invasori cominciano a soggiogare gli abitanti. Questi, da parte loro, si riuniscono sotto la guida di un religioso e intraprendono una sanguinosa guerra.

programme.title: Per 100.000 dollari t'ammazzo
programme.desc: Johnny Forest, cacciatore di taglie, vuole esaudire l'ultimo desiderio della madre: catturare vivo suo fratello fuorilegge, Clint. Mentre cercano di sfuggire a Jurago, un ex socio ostile, Clint accetta temporaneamente l'aiuto di Johnny e decide di arrendersi, almeno per il momento.

programme.title: Non aspettare Django, spara
programme.desc: Django torna a casa e scopre che suo padre è stato ucciso dai banditi locali in un affare andato male.

programme.title: Di Tresette ce n'è uno, tutti gli altri son nessuno
programme.desc: Tresette, affiancato dal suo imponente compagno Paco, si trova coinvolto in una serie di scontri contro pericolosi pistoleri e membri del Ku Klux Klan. Tra duelli, imboscate e situazioni pericolose, i due affrontano avversari sempre più insidiosi in un contesto di violenza e ingiustizia.

programme.title: ...E continuavano a fregarsi il milione di dollari
programme.desc: Il rapinatore Roy King perde la moglie Alicia a causa del rivoluzionario Montero. Nonostante la loro rivalità, i due collaborano nel tentativo di derubare il governo messicano di un milione di dollari.

programme.title: Ehi! Gringo... Scendi dalla croce
programme.desc: Una coppia sposata, impegnata a coltivare una terra difficile, vede la propria vita sconvolta dall'arrivo di uno sconosciuto. L'uomo ha un obiettivo preciso: sabotare la nuova ferrovia. La sua presenza porta tensione e mistero nella tranquilla comunità rurale.

programme.title: 100.000 dollari per Lassiter
programme.desc: Martin è sfruttato dai banditi finché Lassiter non gli rivela il nascondiglio di colui che lo ha reso storpio.

programme.title: L'ombra di Zorro
programme.desc: I fratelli Billy e Dan vanno in California per uccidere Zorro e vendicare la morte del loro fratello.

programme.title: I quattro inesorabili
programme.desc: Quattro cacciatori di taglie del Texas cercano vendetta contro un ranger che ha scagionato il loro ricercato.

programme.title: Tutto per tutto
programme.desc: A El Paso, l'indiano Faccia di Rame cerca vendetta contro il ladro Carranza per l'oro rubato.

programme.title: È tornato Sabata... hai chiuso un'altra volta!
programme.desc: Il feroce pistolero Sabata protegge i deboli e caccia un sindaco corrotto che ha truffato un'intera città.

programme.title: Stelle del Grande Schermo
programme.desc: La serie che celebra i grandi attori degli ultimi 90 anni.

programme.desc: La serie che celebra i grandi attori degli ultimi 90 anni.

programme.desc: Tutte le news che vi siete persi dalla redazione di HotCorn: tra ospiti, interviste e grandi novità al cinema.

programme.title: Harvey Weinstein
programme.sub-title: Il Segreto più Oscuro di Hollywood
programme.desc: Harvey Weinstein, da re di Hollywood a simbolo di uno dei sistemi di abuso più violenti della storia moderna.

programme.title: Hot Corn Cine News Ep.12
programme.desc: Tutte le news che vi siete persi dalla redazione di HotCorn: tra ospiti, interviste e grandi novità al cinema.

programme.title: I Video Che Inventarono Gli Anni '90
programme.desc: Uno speciale di un'ora che ripercorre l'epoca d'oro dei video clip: gli anni '90.

programme.title: Pop Profiles
programme.desc: La storia delle popstar più iconiche del nostro tempo, raccontata tramite i loro singoli di maggior successo.
